Founded in 1725, Botín is recognized by Guinness World Records as the world’s oldest restaurant, and it’s absolutely worth the hype.

Today, our guide Sam takes us from the oven to the first bite, showing what makes this Madrid classic so memorable.

Join us on tour to discover the best of Madrid, from traditional churrerías and bares de toda la vida (beloved neighborhood bars) to bustling markets and iconic local restaurants. Meet the people keeping these culinary traditions alive, and taste your way through the flavors that make Madrid so special.
